Home / About

A field guide, not an official site.

Better Ibaan is an independent civic project. It gathers what the Municipality of Ibaan and other public sources already publish, and puts it in one readable place.

No ads. No tracking. No contact form. No claim to speak for the town.

Why “Iba ang Ibaan”?

The town is named for the Iba tree. In Tagalog, iba also means “different.” The phrase leans on both meanings, but the guide does not need the pun to work. It is simply the shortest way to say: this place is specific, and it deserves a specific guide.

What this is

  • A sourced field guide to Ibaan, Batangas.
  • A readable index of the town’s 26 barangays, geography, heritage, and public record.
  • A static site with no accounts, no comments, and no advertising.
  • An open-data project: the map data and barangay list are downloadable.

What this is not

  • Not an official website of the Municipality of Ibaan.
  • Not a substitute for the municipal profile, the Sangguniang Bayan, or any public office.
  • Not a complete archive. If a page is missing, it may simply not have been added yet.
  • Not a source of legal, property, or boundary advice.

How the facts are handled

Municipal facts come from the Municipality of Ibaan’s own pages. Population and household figures are the 2020 census values as stated in the municipal profile. The Iba tree feature is a summary of the municipality’s Filipino-language heritage entry. The English is ours, not an official translation.

Where official pages disagree, the guide records the disagreement and leaves the figure out. The municipal profile and its geography section currently give different elevations and different distances to Manila. Neither figure is published here. The figure notes are on the sources page.

How the maps are handled

The barangay and provincial maps use the PSA and NAMRIA 2023 administrative boundary file, as published in the MIT-licensed barangay-boundaries-repository. The geometry is simplified at roughly 500 metres. The map is an orientation aid, not a survey, and it does not settle any legal boundary.

Why the guide points outward

The record belongs to the town. Where an official page exists, this guide links to it instead of copying it wholesale. That keeps the source visible, and it keeps this project from pretending to be the municipality.

Technology

Better Ibaan is a static Astro site. Search, the barangay filter, the theme control, and the map readout run in the browser. There is no backend and no analytics script. The site uses self-hosted Source Serif 4 and Public Sans.

Start with a source

If you need an official answer, the municipal profile is the right place to begin. The sources page lists the rest.
